title: The horizon clears
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the rocky ocean below the lighthouse cliff, huge waves, reefs and sea spray, the lighthouse standing on the cliff above. Time and weather: clear golden morning, warm amber sunlight, calm sparkling ocean, gentle breeze.
Camera: sweeping aerial shot over the calm ocean; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Golden light stretches across a calm, sparkling ocean; the reef glistens and the lighthouse stands proud on its cliff in the clear morning.
No dialogue.
Sound: calm waves, gulls, soft breeze.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the scene), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.

No dialogue.
